title: Measures on X × Y that agree on rectangles with μ-finite base are equal (μ σ-finite, ρ₁ finite on μ-finite cylinders)
statement: Let X, Y be measurable spaces, μ a σ-finite measure on X, and ρ₁, ρ₂ measures on X × Y with the product σ-algebra. Suppose (F) ρ₁(A × Y) ≠ ∞ for every measurable A ⊆ X with μ(A) ≠ ∞, and (R) ρ₁(A × B) = ρ₂(A × B) for every measurable A ⊆ X with μ(A) ≠ ∞ and every measurable B ⊆ Y. Then ρ₁ = ρ₂.
lean_statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] (μ : Measure X) (ρ₁ ρ₂ : Measure (X × Y)), SigmaFinite μ → (∀ A : Set X, MeasurableSet A → μ A ≠ ∞ → ρ₁ (A ×ˢ (univ : Set Y)) ≠ ∞) → (∀ (A : Set X) (B : Set Y), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → μ A ≠ ∞ → ρ₁ (A ×ˢ B) = ρ₂ (A ×ˢ B)) → ρ₁ = ρ₂
